source: btp-confort-avenir (maçonnerie, plomberie, combles, sections notées 4-5), h-renovation (maisons après la pluie, tuiles, gouttière, sections notées 4-5 ; échafaudage refait), simple-travaux (404 du tuyau qui fuit), menuizim (atelier de menuiserie).
style: Editorial architectural photography, realistic and natural, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, muted contrast, fine real textures, full-frame camera, sharp focus, clean composition with generous negative space.
interdits: No before/after, no damaged or broken work, no unsafe scaffolding, no worker without protective equipment, no company vehicle, no site sign, no recognizable house presented as a real project.
evite: Évite l'échafaudage décollé du mur et le faux chantier du client : on montre un travail propre et fini, des mains gantées en bord de cadre, jamais d'avant/après.

404.consigne: A copper pipe elbow with a small playful jet of water spraying from a loose joint, a bright bucket below catching the water, white wall and light wooden floor, humorous but clean scene, nobody.

ouverture.consigne: Wide view of {sujet} seen at a three-quarter angle just after rain, wet garden path, sky clearing with a pale break of light, calm and reassuring.

section-fond.consigne: Macro view of {matieres} with rain droplets pearling into round beads, low grazing light, shallow depth of field, no people, no tools.
section-fond.evite: Les matériaux abîmés ou cassés (consigne « no damaged or broken sheets »).

scene-metier.consigne: Close-up of {sujet} on a tidy site, neat professional workmanship, a work-gloved hand at the edge of the frame (hand only, no face, no body), raking sunlight revealing the texture.
scene-metier.source: btp-confort-avenir metier-maconnerie (section notée 4-5, gant jugé correct)
scene-metier.evite: Le visage de l'ouvrier et la main nue aux doigts douteux.

lieu.consigne: Clean finished work inside {sujet}, bare walls around, front view, soft even light with a warm highlight, no people.

texture.consigne: Straight-on texture of {matieres}, raking light revealing the relief, filling the whole frame edge to edge, no objects.
texture.evite: Les inscriptions sur sacs et matériaux.

portrait-generique.consigne: A worker seen strictly from behind in a plain work jacket and safety helmet, standing on scaffolding that stands flush against the facade with guardrails and toe boards on every level, face never visible.
portrait-generique.source: correction h-renovation (échafaudage contre le mur, garde-corps)
